notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
